lanhome_dewhurst.text: Come in, don't mither about your shoes. 'Mither' means to fuss, by the way. I do it all day.
The canal crosses the Lune on a big aqueduct, 62 feet up. John Rennie designed it and it opened in 1797.
Chipgulls on the quay will have your chips before you have blinked. Hold your food close and look fierce.

then.text: Back for the Lancashire Hotpot? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Sit down, love. You can't hurry a hotpot, so you may as well have a brew.
Potatoes on top, sliced thin and overlapped like roof slates. That's the secret. Well, that and patience.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
